author: imryaan
body:
Galloway,  a map created by imryaan & Xuph.
-------------------------------------
16v16
Red vs Blue
1.7 Compatible
Server hosted by alexanderjoe
2 Monuments per team
Middle chest consists of : 3 Diamond chest-plates & 6 Golden apples
2 Supply chests per team
Images : http://imgur.com/a/7YWLz
DL : N/A     /mvtp Galloway on alexanderjoe's build server
XML : N/A
-------------------------------------
Feedback would be highly appreciated
Updates : Changed the biome colours & added a bridge to the monument from spawn which isn't jump-able so you need a dig a hole down on the monument island to be able to jump across
